semantic_audit_rubric.SUPPORTED: Every factual premise in the Directive is supported by the full frozen supervisor evidence, or the Directive explicitly preserves the uncertainty shown there; the guidance remains high-level.

semantic_audit_rubric.UNCERTAIN: The full frozen supervisor evidence is insufficient to confirm or refute a factual premise in the Directive, or the relationship asserted by the Directive is not established.
